name: rain_calm

source.title: even more rain.wav
source.author: mlaramie
source.notes: 44.1 kHz 16-bit mono, 8.5 minutes of steady rain. Chosen over barkenov's 'Soft rain' (CC0; quiet, hissy, about 7 sharp drops a second) and Ryding's 'Medium rain' (CC BY 4.0; little low end) as the closest to the calm rain it replaces (Wirsbo's, no license stated): a smooth wash with a heavy low end. Stretches picked by profile against the old clips (third octaves within about 2 dB RMS), no sharp drops, level steady within 0.2 dB (scratchpad rain_pick.py).

shape: Each clip is a 2 s swell (0.6 s in, 0.5 s out), as the old ones were: the calm rain plays in place of each of vanilla's rain sounds (MixinClientLevel.dsurround$rainSound), several overlapping at once. Level as the old ones' on average (RMS about -46 dB; their loudest 50 ms read -42, these are steadier, so -43.4 here).
